purpose: Collect contact enquiries from a bilingual publication or service page while preserving language-specific consent and routing.
audience: Readers, customers, or prospects using English or Afrikaans pages

field_settings.labels: Visible bilingual labels are used. Avoid placeholder-only translations.
field_settings.consent: Consent wording must be approved in each language before publishing.
field_settings.routing: Preferred language and enquiry type can route notifications if approved.

confirmations.name: Default confirmation
confirmations.message: Thank you. We have received your enquiry and will route it to the correct team.

notifications.name: Admin notification
notifications.includes: source page, preferred language, enquiry type, message

spam_settings.additional: Turnstile/reCAPTCHA only if installed and approved

accessibility_settings.validation: Test validation in each language variant

data_retention_notes: Review retention, consent record, export/erase readiness, and whether bilingual consent text is approved.
risks: Mixed-language labels may be unsuitable for some page contexts
